悬空石阶依山而凿，嵌在万丈悬崖侧壁。

云雾在脚下翻涌，白茫茫一片深不见底，山风呼啸，吹得衣衫猎猎作响，每一步踏下，都能感受到崖壁的震颤，惊险万分。

小队众人提速疾行，脚步稳而迅捷，灵气护体抵御高空寒风与云雾阴煞，沿着蜿蜒石阶一路向上，距离主峰绝顶越来越近。

行至一处云崖拐点，石阶骤然收窄，仅容两人并行，两侧山壁突兀陡峭，云雾在此处汇聚成一片厚重雾墙，遮挡前路视野，地气阴煞骤然浓稠数倍。

“止步。”

胡九郎骤然抬手，全队瞬间顿住脚步。

“这里是登顶前最后一处天然隘口，地势狭窄、云雾遮眼、山壁藏暗位，是绝佳的伏击之地。甲贺忍必定在此布下死士埋伏，堵死登顶通路。”

李二牛仙家灵感全力铺开，眉头紧锁：“没错，崖壁岩缝、云雾暗处、石阶下方悬空处，全都藏着忍者气息，数量不下三十人，全是甲贺精锐死士，抱守死士执念，不求生还，只求拦路截杀。”

所谓死士，便是以忍道誓言束缚自身，舍弃生念、泯灭心神，只留杀戮本能，悍不畏死、不惧伤痛，擅长同归于尽的搏命暗杀，比普通忍者难缠数倍。

被封印的织田美子轻叹一声：“云崖隘口是上山最后的天然屏障，甲贺忍把最后的精锐死士全派来了，布下孤崖绝命杀阵，你们就算战力再强，在狭窄石阶上也展不开阵型，只会被死死耗在这里。”

茉沫冷声道：“一路闯到这里，什么阵没破过？区区死士埋伏，也想拦得住我们？”

胡九郎目光扫过狭窄石阶与厚重雾墙，冷静分析局势：“石阶狭窄，无法大范围铺开阵型，雷法、大范围符箓容易震塌崖壁，引发山崩连累自身。对方擅长潜行、近身、自爆搏杀，只能缩紧阵型，步步推进，定点清杀，不贪快、不冒进。”

他随即快速排布战术：“我在前引路，布简易八卦锁位，封死忍者潜行绕后路线；范师妹居第二位，小范围雷法定点清雾、逼出隐匿身影；唐门姐妹分列阵型左右，紧贴山壁，防备岩缝偷袭；李安琪在后稳住崖壁灵气，防止斗法引发崩塌；钱丹蛊虫浮空预警，辨识死士阴煞气息；杨瑞随时祭出结界，抵挡自爆冲击波；林佳、李二牛守住阵型后路，防止被人从石阶下方迂回包抄。”

分工落位，众人立刻收紧阵型，两两紧贴，在狭窄石阶上结成紧凑攻守队列，缓慢向着雾墙隘口推进。

刚踏入云雾范围的瞬间——

咻！咻！咻！

Chapter 92: Yunya's dead warrior, the end of the road of endurance - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The suspended stone steps are carved into the mountain and embedded in the side of the cliff.

The clouds and mist surged under my feet, and the vast whiteness was bottomless. The mountain wind roared, making my clothes rustle. Every time I took a step, I could feel the tremor of the cliff, which was extremely thrilling.

The team moved quickly, with steady and swift steps, using spiritual energy to protect their bodies against the cold wind and clouds at high altitudes. They climbed up the winding stone steps, getting closer and closer to the top of the main peak.

When we reached a turning point of a cloud cliff, the stone steps suddenly narrowed, allowing only two people to walk side by side. The mountain walls on both sides were abrupt and steep. The clouds and mist gathered here to form a thick wall of fog, blocking the view of the road ahead. The earth's evil spirit suddenly became several times thicker.

"Stop."

Hu Jiulang suddenly raised his hand, and the whole team instantly stopped.

"This is the last natural pass before climbing to the summit. The terrain is narrow, the clouds and mist cover the eyes, and the mountain walls hide hidden positions. It is an excellent place for an ambush. The Koga Ninja must have laid an ambush with dead soldiers here to block the way to the summit."

Li Erniu's Immortal Family inspiration was spread out with all his strength, and he frowned: "Yes, the cracks in the cliffs, the darkness of the clouds, and the hanging places under the stone steps all contain the aura of ninjas. There are no less than thirty people in total, all of whom are elite warriors of Koga. They are obsessed with defending the warriors. They do not seek to survive, but only to block the road and kill them."

The so-called death warriors are those who bind themselves with the oath of tolerance, abandon their thoughts of life, and annihilate their minds, leaving only their killing instinct. They are brave and fearless of death and pain. They are good at life-threatening assassinations and are several times more difficult to deal with than ordinary ninjas.

The sealed Oda Miko sighed softly: "The Yunya Pass is the last natural barrier up the mountain. Koga Ninja has sent all the last elite soldiers to set up a desperate killing formation on the cliff. No matter how powerful you are, you will not be able to form a formation on the narrow stone steps, and you will only be wasted here."

Momo said coldly: "We have been here all the way. What formation has not been broken? Are there just dead soldiers laying an ambush and trying to stop us?"

Hu Jiulang glanced at the narrow stone steps and the thick wall of fog, and calmly analyzed the situation: "The stone steps are narrow, and it is impossible to spread out the formation in a large area. Thunder spells and large-scale talismans can easily collapse the cliff, causing landslides and harming themselves. The opponent is good at sneaking, close quarters, and self-destruction. They can only tighten the formation, advance step by step, and kill at fixed points. They are not greedy for speed or rash advancement."

He then quickly arranged his tactics: "I will lead the way in front and deploy simple Bagua locks to block the ninja's sneak route around the back; Junior Sister Fan is in second place, using small-scale lightning to clear the fog and force out the hidden figure; the Tang Sect sisters are divided into formations on the left and right, clinging to the mountain wall to guard against sneak attacks in the rock crevices;Li Anqi was behind to stabilize the aura of the cliff to prevent the fighting from causing collapse; the Qiandan Gu worm floated in the air to provide early warning, identifying the sinister aura of the dead; Yang Rui used the barrier at any time to resist the self-destruction shock wave; Lin Jia and Li Erniu guarded the rear of the formation to prevent people from outflanking from under the stone steps."

After the division of labor was in place, everyone immediately tightened their formation, sticking close to each other, forming a compact offensive and defensive formation on the narrow stone steps, and slowly advanced towards the mist wall pass.

The moment he just stepped into the clouds and mist——

Phew!call out!call out!
